verified_facts: Bots now play party quests: they answer their own questions (thinking 4-12 s, up to ~22 s per question with retries), follow on shared steps, take boss turns; players must wait for every member's answer before passing a question.
Player rewards are proven identical with or without a bot in the party; bots never write progress.
Implementation choice: a bot in a party also joins a party quest opened by the player (old behaviour: bots never played party quests), so players who invited a bot now wait for its answers.
The web party card still shows 'play together as a party' only with >= 2 human players, so a party of the child plus a bot only gets quests the bot proposes.
D11: the bot waves and leaves the party 5-10 s after the quest ends unless she starts a new quest; open: does a quest she plays alone count as 'new quest'?
Owner wish: bots simulate real players; lively never boring.

bots_join_player_runs.instructions: Should a bot in the party also play a party quest the player opens?

criteria.yes_join: Yes: a bot member joins every party quest of its party (players wait for its answers like for a human)
criteria.only_bot_proposed: No: bots only play the quests they proposed; in player-opened runs they are absent as before

party_card_with_bot.instructions: Should the party card offer 'play together' when the party is the child plus bots only?

criteria.show_with_bot: Yes: a party with at least one human and one bot can start a party quest
criteria.keep_two_humans: No: keep the button only with two or more human players

d11_new_quest.instructions: During the 5-10 s goodbye wait, what keeps the bot in the party?

criteria.party_quest_or_coop_only: Only a new party quest or co-op the party plays together
criteria.any_quest_she_starts: Any quest she starts, including one she plays alone
